why: These fixtures were written before this remediation and were never regenerated: 48 live AcroForm fields survived on both, they were serialized with object streams so the active-content scan could not see into them, and no provenance record named either one. They presented as finalized participant artifacts and were not.
notReplaced: This family package is a duplicate. vermont/200-00130-form-en covers the same document, pinned to the same source sha256 ff914f49c2a78a8b96d48f1242b70ab12ff7cb25beeeb8b850505357fdf982ed with the same role and library folder, and it is the one the implementation index carries. This package is not in that index at all.
whatThisIsNotSaying: Nothing here decides whether the duplicate package should exist. It says only that its fixtures described a run that no longer describes anything, and that leaving them in place left two files claiming to be filed participant documents when they were unflattened blanks.
